scene_zh: 一份省级电网的发电结构（模拟数据）

views.subject: Share of electricity generation by source
views.subtitle_en: Where the province's electricity comes from, 2019 to 2026.

examples.en: Coal's share fell from 68 percent in 2019 to 49 percent in 2026.
examples.zh: 煤电份额从 2019 年的 68% 降到 2026 年的 49%。

features.note_zh: Coal's share 比 the share of coal 更简洁，也更像报告写法。
features.interpret_zh: 少掉的 19 个百分点基本被风电光伏拿走。

examples.en: Wind and solar grew from 10 percent in 2019 to 33 percent in 2026.
examples.zh: 风电和光伏从 2019 年的 10% 增长到 2026 年的 33%。

features.note_zh: grow from ... to ... 同时给出两头，不需要再加 by。
features.interpret_zh: 涨了 23 个百分点，是结构里变化最大的一块。

examples.en: Coal is still the largest source in 2026, at 49 percent.
examples.zh: 2026 年煤电仍是最大来源，占 49%。

features.note_zh: still 在这里表示“至今仍然”，暗示份额已经下降。
features.interpret_zh: 最大来源不等于多数：49% 不到一半。

examples.en: Hydro held a 10 percent share in 2026, down from 14 percent in 2019.

features.note_zh: hold a share 后接 down from，一句话给出水平和变化。
features.interpret_zh: 水电站受资源和季节限制，份额小幅下滑不代表发电量减少。

examples.en: Gas held steady between 8 and 9 percent throughout the period.
examples.zh: 天然气在整个时期稳定在 8% 到 9% 之间。

features.note_zh: hold steady between A and B 比 stay stable 更有数。
features.interpret_zh: 稳定的是占比；总发电量增长时，天然气的绝对量可能也在涨。

examples.en: Wind and solar kept climbing after 2022, reaching 28 percent in 2025.
examples.zh: 风电和光伏在 2022 年后持续上升，2025 年达到 28%。

features.note_zh: keep climbing 强调连续多年，不是一次性跳升。
features.interpret_zh: 这条线几乎每年都在涨，是整张图里唯一持续扩张的来源。

examples.en: By 2026, the mix is 49 percent coal, 8 percent gas, 10 percent hydro and 33 percent wind and solar.
examples.zh: 到 2026 年，结构是 49% 煤电、8% 天然气、10% 水电和 33% 风电光伏。

features.note_zh: 按数值大小排列各部分，读起来最清楚。
features.interpret_zh: 四项合计 100%，是同一年的结构，不是四年的累计。

views.overview_zh: 煤电从 68% 一路降到 49%，风电光伏从 10% 升到 33%，两条线几乎完全对冲；天然气和水电基本稳定。煤电仍是最大来源，但已不到一半。

general.a2: Coal is still the biggest source, but its share fell from 68 percent in 2019 to 49 percent in 2026. Wind and solar grew from 10 to 33 percent. Gas and hydro stayed fairly small.
general.b1: Coal's share of generation fell from 68 percent in 2019 to 49 percent in 2026, while wind and solar rose from 10 to 33 percent. Gas held steady near 9 percent for most of the period, and hydro slipped from 14 to 10 percent.
general.b2: The mix shifted steadily rather than suddenly. Coal lost 19 percentage points over seven years, falling from 68 to 49 percent, while wind and solar more than tripled their share, from 10 to 33 percent. Hydro declined from 14 to 10 percent, and gas was essentially flat at 8 to 9 percent.

descriptions.ielts: Coal remained the largest source, but its share declined from 68 percent in 2019 to 49 percent in 2026. Wind and solar expanded from 10 to 33 percent, while gas stayed flat at around 9 percent and hydro fell from 14 to 10 percent.
descriptions.business: Coal still supplies 49 percent of generation, but the direction is clear: it has lost 19 points while wind and solar have gained 23. Gas and hydro are stable, so the story is a two-way swap between coal and renewables.

views.subject: Net new power capacity in 2026

examples.en: Solar added 11.2 gigawatts, the largest single block in 2026.
examples.zh: 光伏新增 11.2 吉瓦，是 2026 年最大的一块。

features.note_zh: the largest single block 强调单项，不是合计。
features.interpret_zh: 最大单项也占了净增量的一半以上。

features.note_zh: add + 数值，主语是贡献项本身。
features.interpret_zh: 风电和光伏合计 19.7 吉瓦，是增长的主力。

features.note_zh: 小幅贡献也用 add，不需要换成 increase。
features.interpret_zh: 水电的增量只有光伏的八分之一左右。

examples.zh: 天然气只贡献了 0.8 吉瓦。

features.note_zh: contribute + 数值；just 强调量小。
features.interpret_zh: 天然气还在增加，但规模已经很小。

examples.en: Coal retirements took 1.6 gigawatts off the total.
examples.zh: 煤电退役让总量减少了 1.6 吉瓦。

features.note_zh: take ... off the total 是口语化的减法说法。
features.interpret_zh: 退役量远小于新增量，所以净增仍为正。

examples.en: Net additions reached 20.3 gigawatts by the end of 2026.
examples.zh: 到 2026 年底，净新增装机达到 20.3 吉瓦。

features.note_zh: net additions 是扣掉退役后的净值。
features.interpret_zh: 净增 20.3 吉瓦等于四项新增之和减去煤电退役。

views.overview_zh: 2026 年新增装机以光伏和风电为主，合计 19.7 吉瓦；煤电退役 1.6 吉瓦，净增 20.3 吉瓦。退役规模远小于新增，结构在快速变绿。

general.a2: Solar added the most new capacity, at 11.2 gigawatts. Wind added 8.5, and hydro and gas added small amounts. Coal retirements took away 1.6 gigawatts, so the total net gain was 20.3 gigawatts.
general.b1: Solar led the additions with 11.2 gigawatts, followed by wind at 8.5. Hydro and gas added 1.4 and 0.8 gigawatts, while coal retirements removed 1.6. Net new capacity for the year came to 20.3 gigawatts.
general.b2: New capacity was dominated by solar, which added 11.2 gigawatts, and wind, which added 8.5. Together they made up 19.7 of the 21.9 gigawatts added before retirements. Coal retirements removed 1.6 gigawatts, leaving net additions at 20.3 gigawatts.

descriptions.ielts: Solar and wind were the largest sources of new capacity in 2026, adding 11.2 and 8.5 gigawatts respectively. Hydro and gas contributed 1.4 and 0.8 gigawatts, while coal retirements reduced capacity by 1.6 gigawatts, giving a net increase of 20.3 gigawatts.
descriptions.business: Solar and wind delivered 19.7 of the 21.9 gigawatts of gross additions in 2026; coal retirements removed 1.6, leaving 20.3 gigawatts net. The portfolio is growing quickly but depends heavily on two technologies.
